name: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Standard 2022
description: Cross-provider ISO/IEC 27001:2022 mapping consolidated from the existing Prowler provider-specific frameworks. Retains the 92 Annex A controls represented in those frameworks, including manual controls, their provider check mappings, and configuration guardrails.

requirements.name: Policies for information security
requirements.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies should be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information security policy and topic-specific policies should be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.

requirements.name: Roles and Responsibilities
requirements.description: Information security roles and responsibilities should be defined and allocated according to the organisation needs.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information security roles and responsibilities should be defined and allocated according to the organisation needs.

requirements.name: Segregation of Duties
requirements.description: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility should be segregated.

attributes.Check_Summary: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility should be segregated.

requirements.name: Management Responsibilities
requirements.description: Management should require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization.

attributes.Check_Summary: Management should require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization.

requirements.name: Contact With Authorities
requirements.description: The organisation should establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

attributes.Check_Summary: The organisation should establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

requirements.name: Contact With Special Interest Groups
requirements.description: The organisation should establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.

attributes.Check_Summary: The organisation should establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.

requirements.name: Threat Intelligence
requirements.description: Information relating to information security threats should be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information relating to information security threats should be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

requirements.name: Information Security In Project Management
requirements.description: Information security should be integrated into project management.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information security should be integrated into project management.

requirements.name: Inventory Of Information And Other Associated Assets
requirements.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, should be developed and maintained.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Inventory Of Information And Other Associated Assets
attributes.Check_Summary: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, should be developed and maintained.

requirements.name: Acceptable Use Of Information And Other Associated Assets
requirements.description: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets should be identified, documented and implemented.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Acceptable Use Of Information And Other Associated Assets
attributes.Check_Summary: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets should be identified, documented and implemented.

requirements.name: Return Of Assets
requirements.description: Personnel and other interested parties as appropriate should return all the organisation’s assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

attributes.Check_Summary: Personnel and other interested parties as appropriate should return all the organisation’s assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

requirements.name: Classification Of Information
requirements.description: Information should be classified according to the information security needs of the organisation based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information should be classified according to the information security needs of the organisation based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.

requirements.name: Labelling Of Information
requirements.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling should be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organisation.

attributes.Check_Summary: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling should be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organisation.

requirements.name: Information Transfer
requirements.description: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements should be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organisation and between the organisation and other parties.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements should be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organisation and between the organisation and other parties.

requirements.name: Access Control
requirements.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets should be established

attributes.Check_Summary: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets should be established

requirements.name: Identity Management
requirements.description: The full lifecycle of identities should be managed.

attributes.Check_Summary: The full lifecycle of identities should be managed.

requirements.name: Authentication Information
requirements.description: Allocation and management of authentication information should be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on the appropriate handling of authentication information.

attributes.Check_Summary: Allocation and management of authentication information should be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on the appropriate handling of authentication information.

requirements.name: Access Rights
requirements.description: Access rights to information and other associated assets should be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organisation’s topic-specific policy on and rules for access control.

attributes.Check_Summary: Access rights to information and other associated assets should be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organisation’s topic-specific policy on and rules for access control.

requirements.name: Information Security In Supplier Relationships
requirements.description: Processes and procedures should be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier’s products or services.

attributes.Check_Summary: Processes and procedures should be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier’s products or services.

requirements.name: Addressing Information Security Within Supplier Agreements
requirements.description: Relevant information security requirements should be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Addressing Information Security Within Supplier Agreements
attributes.Check_Summary: Relevant information security requirements should be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.

requirements.name: Managing Information Security In The ICT Supply Chain
requirements.description: Processes and procedures should be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Managing Information Security In The ICT Supply Chain
attributes.Check_Summary: Processes and procedures should be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.

requirements.name: Monitor, Review And Change Management Of Supplier Services
requirements.description: The organisation should regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Monitor, Review And Change Management Of Supplier Services
attributes.Check_Summary: The organisation should regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.

requirements.name: Information Security For Use Of Cloud Services
requirements.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services should be established in accordance with the organisation’s information security requirements.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Information Security For Use Of Cloud Services
attributes.Check_Summary: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services should be established in accordance with the organisation’s information security requirements.

requirements.name: Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation
requirements.description: The organization should plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation
attributes.Check_Summary: The organization should plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.

requirements.name: Assessment And Decision On Information Security Events
requirements.description: The organisation should assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorised as information security incidents.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Assessment And Decision On Information Security Events
attributes.Check_Summary: The organisation should assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorised as information security incidents.

requirements.name: Response To Information Security Incidents
requirements.description: Information security incidents should be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information security incidents should be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

requirements.name: Learning From Information Security Incidents
requirements.description: Knowledge gained from information security incidents should be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.

attributes.Check_Summary: Knowledge gained from information security incidents should be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.

requirements.name: Collection Of Evidence
requirements.description: The organisation should establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.

attributes.Check_Summary: The organisation should establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.

requirements.name: Information Security During Disruption
requirements.description: The organisation should plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

attributes.Check_Summary: The organisation should plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

requirements.name: Readiness For Business Continuity
requirements.description: ICT readiness should be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.

attributes.Check_Summary: ICT readiness should be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.

requirements.name: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
requirements.description: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organisations approach to meet these requirements should be identified, documented and kept up to date.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
attributes.Check_Summary: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organisations approach to meet these requirements should be identified, documented and kept up to date.

requirements.name: Intellectual Property Rights
requirements.description: The organisation should implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

attributes.Check_Summary: The organisation should implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

requirements.name: Protection Of Records
requirements.description: Records should be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorised access and unauthorised release.

attributes.Check_Summary: Records should be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorised access and unauthorised release.

requirements.name: Privacy And Protection Of PII
requirements.description: The organisation should identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII according to applicable laws and regulations and contractual requirements.

attributes.Check_Summary: The organisation should identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII according to applicable laws and regulations and contractual requirements.

requirements.name: Independent Review Of Information Security
requirements.description: The organisations approach to managing information security and its implementation including people, processes and technologies should be reviewed independently at planned intervals, or when significant changes occur.

attributes.Check_Summary: The organisations approach to managing information security and its implementation including people, processes and technologies should be reviewed independently at planned intervals, or when significant changes occur.

requirements.name: Compliance With Policies, Rules And Standards For Information Security
requirements.description: Compliance with the organisations information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules and standards should be regularly reviewed.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Compliance With Policies, Rules And Standards For Information Security
attributes.Check_Summary: Compliance with the organisations information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules and standards should be regularly reviewed.

requirements.name: Documented Operating Procedures
requirements.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities should be documented and made available to personnel who need them.

attributes.Check_Summary: Operating procedures for information processing facilities should be documented and made available to personnel who need them.

requirements.name: Screening
requirements.description: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel should be carried out prior to joining the organisation and on an ongoing basis taking into consideration applicable laws, regulations and ethics and be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

attributes.Check_Summary: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel should be carried out prior to joining the organisation and on an ongoing basis taking into consideration applicable laws, regulations and ethics and be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

requirements.name: Terms and Conditions Of Employment
requirements.description: The employment contractual agreements should state the personnel’s and the organisations responsibilities for information security.

attributes.Check_Summary: The employment contractual agreements should state the personnel’s and the organisations responsibilities for information security.

requirements.name: Information Security Awareness, Education And Training
requirements.description: Personnel of the organisation and relevant interested parties should receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organisations information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Information Security Awareness, Education And Training
attributes.Check_Summary: Personnel of the organisation and relevant interested parties should receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organisations information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

requirements.name: Disciplinary Process
requirements.description: A disciplinary process should be formalised and communicated to take actions against personnel and other relevant interested parties who have committed an information security policy violation.

attributes.Check_Summary: A disciplinary process should be formalised and communicated to take actions against personnel and other relevant interested parties who have committed an information security policy violation.

requirements.name: Responsibilities After Termination Or Change Of Employment
requirements.description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment should be defined, enforced and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Responsibilities After Termination Or Change Of Employment
attributes.Check_Summary: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment should be defined, enforced and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties.

requirements.name: Confidentiality Or Non-Disclosure Agreements
requirements.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organisation’s needs for the protection of information should be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel and other relevant interested parties.

attributes.Check_Summary: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organisation’s needs for the protection of information should be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel and other relevant interested parties.

requirements.name: Remote Working
requirements.description: Security measures should be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organisation’s premises.

attributes.Check_Summary: Security measures should be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organisation’s premises.

requirements.name: Information Security Event Reporting
requirements.description: The organisation should provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.

attributes.Check_Summary: The organisation should provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.

requirements.name: Physical Security Perimeters
requirements.description: To prevent unauthorised physical access, damage and interference to the organisations information and other associated assets.

attributes.Check_Summary: To prevent unauthorised physical access, damage and interference to the organisations information and other associated assets.

requirements.name: Physical Entry
requirements.description: Secure areas should be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.

attributes.Check_Summary: Secure areas should be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.

requirements.name: Securing Offices, Rooms And Facilities
requirements.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities should be designed and implemented.

attributes.Check_Summary: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities should be designed and implemented.

requirements.name: Physical Security Monitoring
requirements.description: Premises should be continuously monitored for unauthorised physical access.

attributes.Check_Summary: Premises should be continuously monitored for unauthorised physical access.

requirements.name: Protecting Against Physical and Environmental Threats
requirements.description: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats to infrastructure should be designed and implemented.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Protecting Against Physical and Environmental Threats
attributes.Check_Summary: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats to infrastructure should be designed and implemented.

requirements.name: Working In Secure Areas
requirements.description: Security measures for working in secure areas should be designed and implemented.

attributes.Check_Summary: Security measures for working in secure areas should be designed and implemented.

requirements.name: Clear Desk And Clear Screen
requirements.description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities should be defined and appropriately enforced.

attributes.Check_Summary: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities should be defined and appropriately enforced.

requirements.name: Equipment Siting And Protection
requirements.description: Equipment should be sited securely and protected.

attributes.Check_Summary: Equipment should be sited securely and protected.

requirements.name: Security Of Assets Off-Premises
requirements.description: Off-site assets should be protected.

attributes.Check_Summary: Off-site assets should be protected.

requirements.name: Storage Media
requirements.description: Storage media should be managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the organisations classification scheme and handling requirements.

attributes.Check_Summary: Storage media should be managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the organisations classification scheme and handling requirements.

requirements.name: Supporting Utilities
requirements.description: Information processing facilities should be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information processing facilities should be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

requirements.name: Cabling Security
requirements.description: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services should be protected from interception

attributes.Check_Summary: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services should be protected from interception

requirements.name: Equipment Maintenance
requirements.description: Equipment should be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.

attributes.Check_Summary: Equipment should be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.

requirements.name: Secure Disposal Or Re-Use Of Equipment
requirements.description: Items of equipment containing storage media should be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Secure Disposal Or Re-Use Of Equipment
attributes.Check_Summary: Items of equipment containing storage media should be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

requirements.name: User Endpoint Devices
requirements.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices should be protected.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices should be protected.

requirements.name: Privileged Access Rights
requirements.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights should be restricted and managed.

attributes.Check_Summary: The allocation and use of privileged access rights should be restricted and managed.

requirements.name: Information Access Restriction
requirements.description: Access to information and other associated assets should be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.

attributes.Check_Summary: Access to information and other associated assets should be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.

requirements.name: Access To Source Code
requirements.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries should be appropriately managed.

attributes.Check_Summary: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries should be appropriately managed.

requirements.name: Secure Authentication
requirements.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures should be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

attributes.Check_Summary: Secure authentication technologies and procedures should be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

requirements.name: Capacity Management
requirements.description: The use of resources should be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

attributes.Check_Summary: The use of resources should be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

requirements.name: Protection Against Malware
requirements.description: Protection against malware should be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

attributes.Check_Summary: Protection against malware should be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

requirements.name: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
requirements.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use should be obtained, the organisations exposure to such vulnerabilities should be evaluated and appropriate measures should be taken.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use should be obtained, the organisations exposure to such vulnerabilities should be evaluated and appropriate measures should be taken.

requirements.name: Configuration Management
requirements.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks should be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

attributes.Check_Summary: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks should be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

requirements.name: Information Deletion
requirements.description: Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media should be deleted when no longer required.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media should be deleted when no longer required.

requirements.name: Data Masking
requirements.description: Data masking should be used in accordance with the organisation’s topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.

attributes.Check_Summary: Data masking should be used in accordance with the organisation’s topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.

requirements.name: Data Leakage Prevention
requirements.description: Data leakage prevention measures should be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

attributes.Check_Summary: Data leakage prevention measures should be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

requirements.name: Information Backup
requirements.description: Backup copies of information, software and systems should be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

attributes.Check_Summary: Backup copies of information, software and systems should be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

requirements.name: Redundancy of information processing facilities
requirements.description: Information processing facilities should be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability

attributes.Check_Summary: Information processing facilities should be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability

requirements.name: Logging
requirements.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events should be produced, stored, protected and analysed.

attributes.Check_Summary: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events should be produced, stored, protected and analysed.

requirements.name: Monitoring Activities
requirements.description: Networks, systems and applications should be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

attributes.Check_Summary: Networks, systems and applications should be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

requirements.name: Clock Synchronisation
requirements.description: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organisation should be synchronised to approved time sources.

attributes.Check_Summary: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organisation should be synchronised to approved time sources.

requirements.name: Use of Privileged Utility Programs
requirements.description: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls should be restricted and tightly controlled

attributes.Check_Summary: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls should be restricted and tightly controlled

requirements.name: Installation of Software on Operational Systems
requirements.description: Procedures and measures should be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Installation of Software on Operational Systems
attributes.Check_Summary: Procedures and measures should be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

requirements.name: Network Security
requirements.description: Networks and network devices should be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

attributes.Check_Summary: Networks and network devices should be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

requirements.name: Security of Network Services
requirements.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services should be identified, implemented and monitored.

attributes.Check_Summary: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services should be identified, implemented and monitored.

requirements.name: Segregation of Networks
requirements.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services should be identified, implemented and monitored.

attributes.Check_Summary: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services should be identified, implemented and monitored.

requirements.name: Web Filtering
requirements.description: Access to external websites should be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

attributes.Check_Summary: Access to external websites should be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

requirements.name: Use of Cryptography
requirements.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, should be defined and implemented.

attributes.Check_Summary: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, should be defined and implemented.

requirements.name: Secure Development Life Cycle
requirements.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems should be established and applied.

attributes.Check_Summary: Rules for the secure development of software and systems should be established and applied.

requirements.name: Application Security Requirements
requirements.description: Information security requirements should be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

attributes.Check_Summary: Information security requirements should be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

requirements.name: Secure Systems Architecture and Engineering Principles
requirements.description: Principles for engineering secure systems should be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Secure Systems Architecture and Engineering Principles
attributes.Check_Summary: Principles for engineering secure systems should be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.

requirements.name: Security Testing in Development and Acceptance
requirements.description: Security testing processes should be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Security Testing in Development and Acceptance
attributes.Check_Summary: Security testing processes should be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.

requirements.name: Outsourced Development
requirements.description: The organisation should direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.

attributes.Check_Summary: The organisation should direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.

requirements.name: Separation of Development, Test and Production Environments
requirements.description: Development, testing and production environments should be separated and secured.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Separation of Development, Test and Production Environments
attributes.Check_Summary: Development, testing and production environments should be separated and secured.

requirements.name: Change Management
requirements.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems should be subject to change management procedures.

attributes.Check_Summary: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems should be subject to change management procedures.

requirements.name: Test Information
requirements.description: Test information should be appropriately selected, protected and managed.

attributes.Check_Summary: Test information should be appropriately selected, protected and managed.

requirements.name: Protection of Information Systems During Audit Testing
requirements.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems should be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.

attributes.Objetive_Name: Protection of Information Systems During Audit Testing
attributes.Check_Summary: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems should be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
